hypothesis: Check the validation-selected candidate under another initialization and shuffle seed; not an independent held-out evaluation.
test_policy: Training and original validation only; do not load test images or use test metrics.
comparison_note: Compare with existing widecnn-extended-lr1e-3-s2112-v1 in the same environment. Change only scheduler or BatchNorm, not both. Defaults preserve the original model.
stopping_rule: At most 30 epochs, five non-improving validation macro-F1 epochs, or 300 seconds checked between epochs. Final checkpoint verification and training-fit evaluation can add overhead.
